repo.description:
# Impact

In the bundled Automation plugin, the "Add user to group through User Custom Field" script adds a user to a group selected by the value of a user field. When the script used a free-text user field, a user could make it select an automatic group, such as admins or moderators. Any person who can create an account could do this.

With the default settings, membership in these groups lets the user edit other users' posts, delete topics, and read content restricted to these groups. The user does not get the admin or moderator role, and cannot open the admin interface.

Only sites that enabled the Automation plugin and configured this script on a free-text user field are affected.

# Workarounds
- Disable the automation, or
- Change the user field that the automation uses to a dropdown.

To find affected accounts, examine the group logs of the automatic groups for members that the system user added.

# After the update

The script no longer adds users to automatic groups. It can still add users to any other group that has a full name, so use it with a free-text field only for groups that any user may join.

Discovered by Anthropic's OSS Scanner, as vulnerability ANT-2026-6JM1BR5X.
repo.summary: Unauthorized group membership via user field automation
